fields.description:
## Prototype

Clickable climbing **session** create flow (sessions contain climbs and attempts).

**Entry:** Dashboard → **Start climbing session**

**Routes:**

* `/sessions/create` → `/sessions/[id]/active` — active session builder
* `/sessions/[id]` — completed session view

**Local web:** http://localhost:8081/dashboard

**Scenarios:** http://localhost:8081/scenarios (ROKJ-16 section)

**Mock behaviour:**

* Date/start time auto-filled (editable)
* Location from home gym; inline add if none
* Sort/filter/search climbs; add/edit climbs with attempts, tags, media placeholders
* End session: private default; public requires username
* Share session/climb shows mock copy banner

comments.body:
Review: <custom data-type="status" data-id="id-0">not approved</custom>  
Please address:  

|  | **Summary** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | ‘Happy path’ scenario | Expected happy path to be a user with profile already fully set up |
| 2 | Need a scenario where it’s a new user  | To show what it would look like when no added climbing sessions yet |
| 3 | When profile isn’t fully set up  | user must still be able to start a climbing session and just prompt when something crucial is missing |
| 5 | Adding a location in the climbing log doesn’t work | After typing something in location name and clicking ‘add location now' nothing happens. Should be similar journey to the member profile for searching, adding a nickname and adding difficulty levels |
| 6 | Location is not required for a climbing log |  |
| 7 | **Please assume standards set on other Jira tickets are the default unless difference is requested specifically** | e.g. on <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-1">https://satsumya.atlassian.net/browse/ROKJ-15</custom> “Required and optional field communication: Use an \* for required fields and don’t mention optional as that is already implied“ |
| 8 | End time usability | Make it a dropdown that you can choose to type in or select from options |
| 9 | Avoid telling people to go elsewhere to edit a field if they could update it when it’s relevent | e.g. Instead of saying “End time will be 16:02 unless you set one above.“ put the end time/duration fields near the confirm and save session |
| 10 | Duration | Make it a dropdown that you can choose from common options e.g. 30mins, 45mins, 1hr,1.5hr,2hr etc |
| 11 | Hide the search and filter | When there’s no climbs or only one hide the search and filter |
| 12 | Save/end session | Open a bottom sheet with the private/public option and end time/duration |
| 13 | Do not specify (default) if it’s already implied | e.g. “Private (default” should just be “Private” |
| 14 | Date format | Update to “Day DD Mmm YYYY” e.g. Friday 03 Jul 2026 |
| 15 | Adding username for public session | Previously we’d made the username “thegoat” the way to test a username being attempted to being added that’s already taken but the error handling allowed the username “thegoat”. There needs to be username validation like in the profile setup |
| 16 | Return to dashboard | Allow users to go back to the dashboard if they’re in the middle of adding a climbing session without having to save/end the session (it should just save where it is especially since it’s not published yet |
| 17 | When to show share session  | Only show the option to share when a session is saved or ended |
